extensionDescription.message: A handy extension for managing your Twitch stream.

streamTitleLabel.description: Label for the stream title input.

postToXSectionLabel.description: Label for the custom text area for X (Twitter).

customHashtagsPlaceholder.description: Placeholder for the custom hashtags textarea.

includeCategoryCheckbox.description: Checkbox to include the category as a hashtag.

toastHistoryEmpty.description: Suggestion item when there is no category history.
